hooks.command: command -v graphify >/dev/null 2>&1 && graphify hook-guard search || exit 0
command -v graphify >/dev/null 2>&1 && graphify hook-guard read || exit 0

command -v graphify >/dev/null 2>&1 || exit 0; f=$(node -e 'let d="";process.stdin.on("data",c=>d+=c);process.stdin.on("end",()=>{try{const t=JSON.parse(d).tool_input;process.stdout.write((t&&t.file_path)||"")}catch(e){}})'); case "$f" in *.ts) graphify update . >/dev/null 2>&1;; esac; exit 0
